headline: John Ternus teases 'huge launch next week' in first memo as Apple CEO
summary: John Ternus has officially taken over as Apple's new CEO, sending his first memo to employees. He also hinted at a significant product unveiling scheduled for next week.
details: Apple's newly appointed CEO, John Ternus, has sent his first memo to employees, confirming his new role and teasing an upcoming major event. In the memo, Ternus stated, 'We have a huge launch next week that I can't wait to share with the world.'

This announcement comes alongside a new regulatory filing by Apple, which revealed details of Ternus's pay package. The filing indicates a significant compensation structure for the new chief executive, starting with a reported $58 million.

Ternus, previously Apple's Senior Vice President of Hardware Engineering, officially stepped into the CEO position today. He has been a key figure in the development of numerous Apple products, including the iPhone, iPad, and Mac.

His memo also outlined his vision for the company's future, emphasizing innovation and continued dedication to Apple's core values. This leadership transition marks a new era for the tech giant, following Tim Cook's tenure as executive chairman.
caption:
Apple's new CEO, John Ternus, just sent his first memo, teasing a 'huge launch next week'! What could be coming?

Apple's newly appointed CEO, John Ternus, has sent his first memo to employees, confirming his new role and teasing an upcoming major event. In the memo, Ternus stated, 'We have a huge launch next week that I can't wait to share with the world.'

This announcement comes alongside a new regulatory filing by Apple, which revealed details of Ternus's pay package. The filing indicates a significant compensation structure for the new chief executive, starting with a reported $58 million.

Ternus, previously Apple's Senior Vice President of Hardware Engineering, officially stepped into the CEO position today. He has been a key figure in the development of numerous Apple products, including the iPhone, iPad, and Mac.

His memo also outlined his vision for the company's future, emphasizing innovation and continued dedication to Apple's core values. This leadership transition marks a new era for the tech giant, following Tim Cook's tenure as executive chairman.
